## Summary

I implemented F003 as a new pure core module `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/upgrade_predicates.py` defining `PredicateResult`, a dependency-injectable `PredicateContext`, and a `predicate_registry` keyed by the two namespaces (`status_probe` / `applies_when`) plus `resolve_status_probe` / `resolve_applies_when` dispatchers. The OUTCOME probe `canonical_discovery_registered_active` reuses ONLY the canonical-discovery reconcile READ path (load ledger→observed, registry→registered, pure `reconcile`) and is satisfied iff the `registered_active` bucket is non-empty — it never reads the evidence file, so per D019 a stale/malformed leftover evidence file cannot flip a proven outcome to pending; evidence validity is gated solely by the separate `canonical_backfill_evidence_valid` predicate (F006 shape contract), and `has_tracked_projects` reflects registry presence.
